title: tests/examples: run example scripts hermetically with the shared db_uri fixture and a patched HTTP helper
answers: How do I write a test that runs a repo example script without calling a real API?
Why is my example test slow on Windows CI because it creates a new SQLite tracking DB?
How do I mock an HTTP helper used by a judge when running examples/ through runpy?
Where do example tests live and how are they structured?
body:
Path: `tests/examples/test_examples.py` runs repository examples from `examples/` (for example `examples/typesafe_judges/evaluate.py`) as tests. `test_typesafe_judges_example` runs that script with `runpy` against a tracking store and checks results, traces and assessment metadata.
Rule: Inject the shared `db_uri` fixture and set the tracking URI to it, restoring the previous URI with `request.addfinalizer`, instead of creating a fresh `tmp_path` SQLite file, which re-runs all migrations and is costly on Windows CI. Stub the network by `mock.patch`-ing the judge's HTTP helper (`mlflow.genai.judges.typesafe._get_http_response_with_retries`) with a `side_effect` that returns a `requests.Response` whose `_content` is the JSON body. Assert the URL, auth header and request payload shape inside the side effect; the production call passes url, headers and json as keyword arguments, so `respond(**kwargs)` is the right signature.
Constraints: Use this for hermetic example tests that need no real key; set the API key with `monkeypatch.setenv`. Live-key validation is done manually and is not part of this test.
applies: Applies to tests that exercise scripts under examples/ that call external model APIs.
says: Automated test runs for sample evaluation scripts take too long on Windows.
Running model evaluation examples in automated checks fails when external services are unreachable.
Enable running sample evaluation tutorials without requiring live external network access.
Speed up example script test execution by reusing database connections during validation.
search: Hermetic testing of example scripts in tests/examples/test_examples.py uses the shared db_uri fixture and mocks external HTTP helpers to evaluate examples without network calls or migration overhead. In test_typesafe_judges_example, the tracking URI is temporarily pointed to db_uri while mlflow.genai.judges.typesafe._get_http_response_with_retries is patched with a side effect verifying URL, auth header, and JSON payload. This applies to examples exercising external model APIs, avoiding costly SQLite file recreations on Windows CI, while live-key verification remains a manual process.
